budget.title: Full-Day Budapest Nature Escape on a Budget + Local Food
budget.summary: Green spaces, riverside walks, island chill zones — plus affordable Hungarian comfort food along the way.

schedule.title: Morning Walk on Margaret Island
schedule.description: Start the day with a calm stroll around Margaret Island. Trees, little gardens, fountains — super chill vibes.

schedule.title: Park Break
schedule.description: Find a shady bench or garden spot. Great moment for snacks, photos, or just some breathing room.

schedule.title: Budget Local Lunch
schedule.description: Hop to a nearby affordable Hungarian place — soups, simple stews, or a classic lángos that won’t hurt your wallet.

schedule.title: Danube Riverside Walk
schedule.description: Follow the riverbank paths in Pest. Peaceful views, boats passing by, and plenty of great photo spots.

schedule.title: Riverside Soft Drink
schedule.description: End the day with a lemonade, fruit drink, or soda on a terrace by the water.

comfortable.title: Full-Day Nature Tour with Comfortable Local Dining
comfortable.summary: A relaxing day filled with greenery, river views, and a comfy classic lunch in a nice Hungarian restaurant.

schedule.title: Margaret Island + Viewpoints
schedule.description: Walk or rent a bike for a loop around the island — lots of cool lookouts and gardens.

schedule.title: City Park (Városliget)
schedule.description: Explore Budapest’s biggest park: little bridges, lake views, and the stunning Vajdahunyad Castle.

schedule.title: Comfortable Traditional Lunch
schedule.description: Sit down at a nice local restaurant in the City Park area — try warm soups or classic Hungarian dishes.

schedule.title: Afternoon Garden Walk
schedule.description: Move through another leafy area or hidden garden; Budapest is packed with cute corners.

schedule.title: Terrace Drink (Non-Alcoholic)
schedule.description: Finish with a fancy lemonade or iced tea at a cozy terrace.

budget.title: Full-Day Nature Tour with Light & Veggie-Friendly Budget Meals
budget.summary: Fresh air, greenery, veggie snacks, and easygoing food picks for a full nature day.

schedule.title: Danube Promenade Morning Walk
schedule.description: A gentle scenic walk along the river — perfect for warming up the day.

schedule.title: City Park Relax Time
schedule.description: Find a sunny or shady spot to chill, read, snack, or take photos.

schedule.title: Veggie-Friendly Budget Lunch
schedule.description: A simple bistro with salads, veggie soups, or plant-based bowls.

schedule.title: Second Green Spot
schedule.description: Visit another park or garden — Budapest has tons of quiet, leafy zones.

schedule.title: Evening Outdoor Drink
schedule.description: Finish with a lemonade or iced drink under the trees.

comfortable.title: Full-Day Nature + Comfortable Light Veggie Dining
comfortable.summary: Lots of walking, lots of greenery, plus fresh veggie-friendly meals in stylish spots.

schedule.title: Riverside Morning Walk
schedule.description: Enjoy the cool air and the calm river before the city gets busy.

schedule.title: Budapest Botanical Garden
schedule.description: Take your time exploring beautiful plant collections and quiet green corners.

schedule.title: Veggie-Friendly Lunch
schedule.description: A quality restaurant with creative plant-based dishes or lighter modern meals.

schedule.title: Park Walk + Coffee
schedule.description: Choose a park with a nearby café and enjoy a specialty coffee or tea.

schedule.title: Rooftop/Outdoor Chill
schedule.description: End the day on a terrace or rooftop with a refreshing non-alcoholic drink.

schedule.title: Riverside Exploration

schedule.title: Park Snack Time
schedule.description: Pick up a little bakery snack or fruit drink and enjoy it on a bench.

schedule.title: Budget Mixed Lunch
schedule.description: Try a couple of small Hungarian dishes — nothing fancy, just fun.

schedule.title: More Nature

schedule.title: Soft Drink by the River
schedule.description: Wrap up with a refreshing drink at a riverside terrace.

comfortable.summary: Scenic nature spots, long relaxing walks, and several tasty food stops.
